title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Mega-cap tech melt-up, everything else flat.
Semis and megacaps drove a record Nasdaq as oil fell 3.68% and yields dropped, but only 58% of S&P names advanced and 71 made new 60-day lows. With SPY bleeding $22.9bn over five days into SMH, this is narrow momentum, not broad accumulation.

INDICES — VIX 14.9, below its 20-day MA of 15.7.
SOXX +4.93%, QQQ +2.77%, SPY +1.55%, DIA +0.76%, IWM +0.52%. Large beat small by 2.25pp. TLT +0.68% was the notable cross-asset move as USO -3.68%. SPY's 29% above-50DMA reading flags a fragile tape, though no 200-DMA trigger confirmed.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.2x, QQQ 1.5x, both gaining with price up = accumulation, but concentrated in megacap (MAGS 3.3x). Losers IJR 0.9x, GLD 0.6x signal neglect. Breadth: 58% advancers, up/down volume 2.10, 11 highs vs 71 lows — participation diverges sharply from the index move.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +2.77%, XLY Discretionary +1.08%, XLV Healthcare +0.37%, XLI Industrials +0.14%, XLRE Real Estate +0.14%, XLF Financials +0.07%, XLC Comms +0.00%, XLE Energy +0.00%, XLB Materials -0.56%, XLP Staples -1.06%, XLU Utilities -1.07%. Top industries IBIT +6.50% and SOXX +4.93%; bottom USO -3.68% and XOP -3.07%. Flows: XLY +711mm (100th pctile) and XLK +76mm in; XLE -879mm (2nd) and XLF -697mm out. Money is entering semis/AI, exiting energy and financials — 'AI hardware leading'.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.82, QQQ 0.97, both below fear thresholds; QQQ skew +6.2% shows modest put premium. VIX 14.9 sits below its 15.7 MA — complacency. VIXEQ 38.7 versus VIX 14.9 is a wide gap — high dispersion, rotation-friendly, not a correlated macro tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -3.68% and TLT +0.68% moved together, easing inflation fear and helping rate-sensitives, but gold -0.70% fell despite risk-on. Next FOMC is Oct 28, 2026; CME FedWatch shows hike 100.0%, while Polymarket prices 56% for a 25bp hike, +6pp in five days.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 47.2, Neutral. INTC +12.14% on SK Hynix Ohio plant talks, META +11.34%, AMD +9.95% on hitting a $1trn market cap. Vol spikes: MAGS 3.3x and META 2.6x, both price-up = accumulation. Watch UNP -3.49% (2.5x volume, trend break) and SLV -0.50% (38.2% IV into falling price).
